notes.title: What I'm working on!
notes.content:
Dear players,

I've been quite busy the last few months. Reason is, i've been building a Kickstarter campaign for a new videogame, "Girl Genius: Adventures In Castle Heterodyne". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/5bd2963acfad96c125ef65adea3d2ee51092b25c.jpg[/img]

For "Viking Chess: Hnefatafl", i've been working behind the scenes with upgrading backend, making it easier to further develop the game. While I can't set a date for a new content update just yet, just know that it's in the works. We've also tested the game on mobile platforms, and with some tweaks and adjustments, I'm hoping to get a release out for mobile. It looks [i]great[/i] on tablets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/5482827449591981933e1e957c7fec500560b126.png[/img]

[h1]Please check out our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ggadventures/girl-genius-adventures-in-castle-heterodyne]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for "Girl Genius: AICH".[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/beeefceca49fe998befc2e15292f646312f2b51f.jpg[/img]

If the Kickstarter is successful, we are developing for PC/Mac/Linux available here on Steam, and Nintendo Switch™, with other consoles as stretch goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/5482827449591981933e1e957c7fec500560b126.png[/img]

Girl Genius™ is the multiple Hugo Award winning graphic novel series by Phil & Kaja Foglio, of fame from the early days of Magic The Gathering, and the comic "What's new with Phil & Dixie" published in Dragon Magazine. Read the comic for free [url=www.girlgeniusonline.com]here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/3fb5c31299a5f6bae90080d244dd6e9406542837.jpg[/img]

Please consider supporting the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ggadventures/girl-genius-adventures-in-castle-heterodyne]Kickstarter campaign[/url], and please help share the campaign with other people. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/5482827449591981933e1e957c7fec500560b126.png[/img]

All the best
- Kenny
Twitter: @raingames_kenny and @rain_games

notes.title: Big Update! We're releasing out of Early Access
notes.content:
Viking Chess: Hnefatafl releases out of Early Access this evening at approximately 19:00 CET!

Please join us this evening for online games. We are gathering a little crew of friends and developers to drink a few horns of mead and play the game with you!

We want to thank all players during Early Access, for your contribution to making Viking Chess a better game. As a homage to all players that helped out the development of this game, we have implemented an unlockable title in your honor; "Shaman". Win the title ingame by "finding the secret bug"!

Among the many fixes and improvements this update, you will find an exciting new feature, namely an unlockable Boardpiece Set. Once you win the set by completing the "Valkyrie" title, you unlock the epic "Valkyrie Set".

Since the 16th of October, and during these months of Early Access we have delivered many content updates and patches, improving the game bit by bit. And now, as we move out of Early Access, we are excited to see how the game develops further, hopefully with some more players coming to the game, and maybe a more active multiplayer scene. Personally, I am proud of this little game, and i am very glad for all the positive remarks and feedback on the game.

We look forward to your continued feedback, and we are aiming to improve the game further through content updates, also after this period of Early Access.

Thank you for your participation in this period of Early Access, and I hope you will enjoy the game for a long time.

All the best!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Update 0.15 - Patch notes
notes.content:
Hello Early Access players!

[b]Patch notes:[/b]

- Added "Restart Game" button to Ingame menu in Singleplayer & Local Hotseat Multiplayer.
- Added "Concede Game" button to Ingame menu in Multiplayer(online). You can now concede a game, meaning that you admit defeat to your opponent and the game ends.
- Fixed default input keys for camera movement, that was set incorrectly last game update, and snuck itself into the update.
- Fixed an issue in Tutorial, where the new Input system did not work to move the camera.
- Fixed an issue in Tutorial, where "Exit to main menu" button did not work.
- Added functionality to let you choose a "Boardpiece package" to play with. These are the 3D models of pieces and associated assets. This feature is not completed yet, but you will see a dropdown menu in Singleplayer game setup where you can select a "Boardpiece set". Coming soon!
- Added unlockable title "Galning": As the Defenders, capture all Attackers

All the best!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Content Update 0.14 EA
notes.content:
Hello Early Access players!

Here's a new content update with a host of new unlockable titles available for you to win, and some fixes and improvements!
Viking Chess: Hnefatafl releases out of Early Access soon! Tell your friends.

[b]** Note ** [/b]
- Your progression and unlocks will be wiped when the game leaves Early Access, but we'll give Early Access players an extra treat with an unique unlockable title that only players in Early Access will recieve -

[b]New unlockable titles:[/b]
Note! Unlockable titles are not available to be unlocked in the Tutorial or in a local hotseat multiplayer game.
- "Raider": Win a game as the Attackers
- "Shield": Win a game as the Defenders
- "Bulwark": As the Defenders, win a game by constructing an Edge Fort
- "Kingslayer": As the Attackers, capture the King!
- "Invader": As the Attackers, end your turn with 4 Attackers around the Throne
- "Blood Axe": As the Attackers, capture all Defenders including the King
- "Suffocator": Play a Shieldwall attack
- "Jotun": Play a Multicapture attack

[b]Fixes and improvements:[/b]
- For Multiplayer games that uses a round timer, the timer is now synced correctly over network.
- Added UI message ingame when an unlockable is unlocked.
- Moving the camera with middle mouse button is now smoother and better.
- Added a new input system. Next patch will include full gamepad support!
- Alot of general internal code optimization, for faster and easier development.

Upcoming features:
- A final AI update in Early Access
- Gamepad support
- Some more unlockable titles
- An exciting new feature. I hear the warcries of the Valkyries in the distance..

All the best!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Important issues and bugfix patch 0.12 EA
notes.content:
[b]Hello Early Access players![/b]

We start the new year by resolving some important issues and bugs.

Thank you to community members that sent descriptive bug and issue reports on our Steam forum!

If you have an issue with the game or believe you've found a bug, please head on over to our Steam forum at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1133070/discussions/1/]our bug report forum[/url] or pop by our [url=https://discord.gg/7HxACrx]Discord[/url].

[b]Patch notes:[/b]

- Important: Resolved an issue where the King could be incorrectly captured in a Shieldwall. Note to players: The King cannot be captured in a Shieldwall in the Copenhagen ruleset of Hnefatafl.
- Important: Resolved an issue where an Edge Fort win condition would not be triggered correctly.
- Minor: Piece count in UI for each faction was not updated correctly when loading a game
- Minor: Reset button in UI was available to click when it was not supposed to be available.
- Minor: EditProfile UI window in Start Menu was enabled when leaving an active game returning to Start Menu.
- Minor: When viewing your Statistics in Edit Profile UI, the scroll speed of the scrollable view is now faster when using the mousewheel.

Going forward, we're developing faster now at the start of the new year. Viking Chess now have [i]two[/i] developers working on the game, so we will try to release more frequent updates the coming weeks. We are aiming to release the game out of Early Access quite soon.

[b]Upcoming content the next weeks:[/b]
- Improved visuals in some areas
- More unlockable prefix titles for your Player Profile
- Feedback when unlocking an unlockable
- Another AI improvement patch
- Steam Achievements


We're [i]considering [/i]one last "heavy" feature for Viking Chess; A custom game editor, where you can setup a boardstate placing pieces on the board and setting up game parameters. Could be used for many things, like creating variants of Hnefatafl with different board sizes and number of pieces, strong/weak King rules, custom win conditions. You can either challenge the AI on a custom board or create a custom game lobby in Multiplayer. We want feedback from the community on this feature, please tell us in the comments or our [url=https://discord.gg/7HxACrx]Discord[/url] or our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1133070/discussions/0/]Steam Forum[/url] if this is a feature you would really, really like to see in the game.

As always, thank you for playing Viking Chess and leaving good reviews for our game!
Viking Chess currently has a [b]positive[/b] rating on Steam, which is great!

All the best
- Kenny G

notes.title: A Dev Diary - Happy Christmas!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

So, just like Andy Williams sings; "It's the most wonderful time of the year", and on that note I thought it would be fun  to give you all a little look behind the scenes of the development of Viking Chess: Hnefatafl.

Viking Chess has been in Early Access since the release on the 16th of October, and since then we have released around 10 updates, big and small. I think the game has improved much over these updates, and I believe we will have a very nice little game by the end of Early Access. I believe that a few more updates are in order to release the game out of Early Access early next year. We all want a better AI to play against, and a fully featured game with good singleplayer, good multiplayer and game progression.

Viking Chess is a very small, niche indiegame with a very low budget, so I thank you all for your patience here in Early Access, while I improve the game little by little.

On the "small game" note: Small niche games like these generally don't have a very active multiplayer scene by themselves. In order to get the multiplayer running, the game needs community involvement that get people together to play. I hope that you players want to use our Discord https://discord.gg/7HxACrx to create a community there, to have a hub that all players can use to find other players and organize games.

[b]This week[/b] I will release the long? awaited content update with many exciting features. Better AI in general, Unlockables, and community requested features like Hotseat local multiplayer. And also some squishing of community discovered bugs. So for those of you that get some time off in the holiday season I hope to see you playing Viking Chess and enjoying the new update! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/7efd00439c9c502de6fc1446ae3b94dd871ce2ea.jpg[/img]
My name is Kenny G and i'm the solo developer on this project, with some help here and there from other colleagues at Rain. Yes, solo, so that's why things take a little bit more time. I do programming, design, well everything except 3D modeling, so I got some help there from my colleague Lars which you can read about later in the post.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/7fff6adabe2e5acbf896268c19fe3e8bc8e2d023.png[/img]
 Here's where i work. I have my own little corner of the world in the Rain office in Bergen, Norway. The porcelain cat is there for motivation, overseeing that I do good work.
Oh and do you notice some small board pieces?

I'm working on creating a very nice physical boardgame prototype for Viking Chess as well, 3D printed here in our office. What do you think? Anyone of you interested in purchasing a nice physical boardgame in the future with our designs? :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/d097038211b74cef939df4d7a60a26dbf87bc2ee.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35640970/e459d25b746ba64d22d159f1fc0ce6cf5b5394e8.jpg[/img]
This is Lars, he's the awesome sculptor of our board pieces. He sculpted the pieces beatifully in the software ZBrush, and made them look fine and dandy in our Game Engine with nice low poly models. He's an allround amazing artist with many projects at all times, a skilled illustrator, modeler and designer. Oh and he does his own comic "No Good Heroes" as well! Check out his work posted regularly @helgemonster on Twitter.

I'm looking forward to have some time in the holiday to work more on Viking Chess and get some great updates out for you guys!
Like always, thank you for playing Viking Chess and supporting my game, and giving feedback. I'm working hard to create the best game I can for you guys, and I hope that you will be happy with the game by the end of Early Access.

I wish you all a happy holiday, and all the best going into the new year!
- Kenny G

notes.title: Upcoming Content Patch 0.11EA
notes.content:
Hello Early Access players!

Here's some news on an upcoming content update.

First off all, we apologize for some delay since the last update. 
We've had some stressfull weeks where we've done work on other projects to put food on our plates.
We're preparing a more meaty content update for you, that needs a little bit more time in the oven to cook just right.

[b]Here's a few of the upcoming features in Content Patch 0.11 EA:[/b]
[list]
[*] Better AI. More finetuned behaviors, and in general a more difficult AI at higher difficulty levels.
[*] Bookkeeping. Recorded game statistics that you can view in your profile to keep track of your progress, like for example number of wins/losses and more cool stuff like number of captures you've made or number of special attacks like shieldwall you've made.
[*] Unlockables. You can unlock prefix titles to garnish your player profile name, and display your commitment and skill-level to your opponents. (Note! Progression *can* be wiped during Early Access and *will* be wiped when we come out of Early Access)
[*] A secret.... title for you to unlock, the "Highlander" title. Any guesses in the comments on how you can unlock it just based on the title reference? :)
[*] Setup for Steam Achievements.
[*] Bugfixes to bugs discovered by the community.
[*] Fix for Multiplayer games that use a turn timer, so that the timer is syncronized for both players.
[/list]

The features listed take a little bit more time to implement than expected, but the content update will be coming soon(tm).

On another note; if you want to find other players to play Multiplayer games with, please use our Discord https://discord.gg/7HxACrx . We want to grow the community there over time, and hope that you players want to use the Discord server as a community hub.

Thank you all for playing our game, and giving valuable feedback to us in our Steam Community!

All the best
- Kenny G

notes.title: Patch notes v.0.09 EA - Content update, UI fixes
notes.content:
Hello Early Access players, here's a new content patch for you!

Note! The patch is available on Windows now, Mac OS players will recieve the patch tomorrow 04.11.

[b]Content:[/b]
- Singleplayer game setup in Start Menu have been reworked to be more in line with the rest of the game's UI.
- Players can now select difficulty levels when playing Singleplayer versus AI!
-- Difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Nightmare.
- Tweaks and updates to each AI difficulty level. Still a work in progress, but we're getting there!
- Overhauled many aspects of the user interface. 
-- Most importantly, all UI screens should now be displayed well on different resolutions.
-- Reworked many UI layouts.
-- Crisper and more readable text in UI.
-- Freshened up some sprite assets.
- New Viking Horn 3D model in all game scenes.
- Higher resolution of lightmaps in all game scenes.

As always, thanks for playing Viking Chess: Hnefatafl and thanks for your feedback so far!

notes.title: Patch 0.08 EA Patch notes
notes.content:
Greetings all Early Access  players and thank you for playing our game and your feedback so far!

Much feedback have been gathered, both from our forums and other sources, and one thing that many players want is a better 2D camera view, viewing the board top down.
So we've created just that! :)

[b]2D ortographic top down view:[/b]
--------------------------------------
- [b]Accessed[/b] by pressing the button <TAB> in game, toggling between top down 2D mode and perspective 3D mode.
- [b]New[/b] movepath graphics when in 2D view mode.
- [b]Adjustments[/b] to 3D models when in 2D view mode, they no longer cast or recieve shadows to have a clearer visual read when viewing them top down in ortographic camera.
- [b]Note![/b] When you have selected an actor that you want to move; while the actor is selected you are not allowed to toggle between top down view mode and perspective. This is intentional.

[b]Please[/b] hop over to the forums or our Discord at https://discord.gg/7HxACrx and tell us if you like the 2D feature or not! Thank you! :)

[b]Tutorial mini-update:[/b]
------------------------------------
- When you do the tutorials for the "Edge Fort" mechanic or the "Defender Enclosure" mechanic, there are now a graphic in tutorial UI which tells you if you were successful or not.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:
------------------------------------
- [b]Fixed[/b] faulty triggers on Win Condition: Defenders are completely enclosed by attackers and no defender can reach the board edge. 

[b]Upcoming Feature(s):[/b]
-----------------------------------
We are working on the progression and bookkeeping system. Soon you can garnish your profile name with unlockable prefix titles, and see your recorded game statistics. Note to all Early Access players! When we implement this feature in Early Access, expect the progression to be wiped after Early Access, so that new and old players start on the same playing field in terms of progression.

Have a good weekend, and GG to you all!

notes.title: Patch notes v.0.07
notes.content:
We've had some busy days after launch in Early Access, with the "Konsoll" game developer conference in Bergen, Norway. Now we're back on it and ready to push out frequent updates.

Thank you all so far for feedback and reviews, we appreciate it!

[b]Patch Notes version 0.07:[/b]

- The AI now selects a Move from a pool of "equally good moves", to encourage dynamic behavior.

- Fixed Win Condition where if a Faction have no available legal moves, that Faction looses the game.

notes.title: Launch! News! Upcoming features!
notes.content:
[b]We are excited[/b] to finally launch in Early Access, and to see the community react to and play our game!

In our "Early Access Description" we stated that AI was expected to be a bit weak at Launch, but.... we have managed to develop an AI in time for launch that performs quite well, and will certainly challenge the new and the average player!

We are excited to hear and see your reactions. 
Please post feedback and reactions in our Steam forum under "Early Access Feedback".
Thank you!

If you find an issue or a bug, please post it in our Steam forum under "Early Access Bug Report". 
Thank you!

[b]Prelaunch hotfix:[/b]

- For players that had access to the game pre-launch there was an issue in Tutorial where Actors were unclickable. This is fixed.
- Updated Credits
- Updated build with newest AI, where the King performs better.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Upcoming features:[/b]

- Prefix title unlockables
-- At Launch this feature is not yet unlocked, so everybody will be "Thralls" for a little while, but it's coming! :)

-Better AI, with difficulty levels
--The current AI performs quite well, but needs a little more ammunition to truly challenge the experienced player.

[b]Upcoming fixes to known issues:[/b]
-Defender Enclosure (Attacker Win Condition)
-- Some rare boardstates can faultily trigger Win Condition that the Defender faction is enclosed by the Attackers. We will get to work on this immediately after Launch. Sorry to any of you beforehand that manage to reach this state in game before we get it fixed.

-UI resolution issues
-- Some UI in the game has issues displaying correctly at different resolutions

Thank you, and we hope you're as excited about this game as we are!
